Hi Stella,

I noticed your rural romance Rain on a Hot Tin Roof arrived in March 2026, with its derelict farm, two broken hearts and a town that cannot help meddling. That setting sounds like a story readers would love to hear more about.

I would love to invite you to be featured in an Author Spotlight on The Author Ledger. The feature is designed to introduce readers to your work, the story behind your book, and the experiences or ideas that have shaped your journey as an author. Alongside our editorial features, we also support authors with professionally produced audiobook editions, cinematic book trailers, short promotional reels, author websites, press kits, Amazon A+ graphics, and book relaunch materials.

If a short trailer or a few reels for Rain on a Hot Tin Roof is something you have been considering, we can handle the full production. It would be a simple way to show the farm, the town and the characters to new readers, and it is entirely optional and separate from the Spotlight.

The Author Spotlight is a paid feature, and I would be happy to share the details and pricing if it sounds like a good fit.

Would you be interested in hearing more about the feature and the option I believe would suit Rain on a Hot Tin Roof best?

Warm regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
The Author Ledger
